text: 2x100 % filtration/separation, 2x100 % water-bath or electric heaters, 2x100 % pressure-reduction streams with active/monitor regulators and slam-shut valves; fiscal metering with 2x100 % ultrasonic meters (OIML R137 accuracy class 0.5), on-line gas chromatograph and flow computers complying with the network operator's requirements.
title: Gas receiving and fiscal metering station
